### The First Organic Coffee Co. - Est. 1980

Cafe Altura formed around a shared belief in the transformative and healing power of Organic and
Regenerative agriculture. In 1980 Chris Shepherd traveled to Chiapas, Mexico in search of coffee
grown without the use of harmful chemicals in methods that cared for both people and the
environment. Today, Cafe Altura is available from Los Angeles to New York. We are based in Ventura,
California where we roast our coffee on vintage roasters and continue to promote organic agriculture
through conscious commerce. [Read the Cafe Altura story here][21].

## What Is Liquid Coffee Concentrate?

Liquid coffee concentrate is brewed coffee reduced down to its purest, most potent form. Think of it
like the essence of espresso, but without the machine. A small amount goes a long way: just 10 ml of
STIR makes a full 100 ml cup of coffee. No grinding, no brewing, no waiting.

It's new to India, but it's been the quiet secret of cafés and specialty coffee lovers worldwide for
years. Now it's yours.

1
Pour 10 ml of STIR
Use the measuring spoon included in every order. 10 ml is your base, go up to 15 ml for a stronger,
bolder cup.
2
Add your liquid
Top up with 90 ml of hot water, cold water, cold milk, hot milk, whatever you like. That's your 100
ml cup right there.
3
Stir and done
Give it a quick stir. For iced coffee, just pour over ice, you're done in under 60 seconds. No
machine, no mess, no skill required.
Is this the same as instant coffee?
Not even close. Instant coffee is spray-dried or freeze-dried powder, the process strips most of the
flavour and aroma. STIR is brewed liquid concentrate made from specialty Arabica. It tastes like
real coffee, because it is real coffee.
Do I need any special equipment?
Nothing. No espresso machine, no French press, no filter setup. Just the concentrate, a cup, and
whatever liquid you have in your kitchen. A 10 ml measuring spoon is included with every order.
Can I use it for iced coffee?
That's where it really shines. Fill a glass with ice, pour 90 ml milk of your choice, top with 10–15
ml of STIR. Iced latte in under 60 seconds, no dilution, no bitterness.
How does it compare to café coffee?
STIR is made from the same single-origin specialty Arabica beans that specialty cafés use, brewed at
the right concentration and sealed fresh. The result is a clean, nuanced cup, not the over-extracted
bitterness of most home methods.
How long does it last?
1 year sealed. Once opened, store it sealed and refrigerated, it stays fresh for 20 days. At 10 ml
per cup, a 200 ml pouch gives you about 20 cups and a 900 ml gives you about 90.

under 60 seconds.

## Founded by a 35-Year Coffee Industry Veteran

All American Coffee LLC was founded in 2018 by Maciek Mierzwinski — a coffee professional whose
career began in Poland in 1990 and has spanned five companies across Europe and America, including
Polish Coffee Company S.A., Unicof Ltd (London), OLAM Polska, and American Coffee Traders, Inc.

Today, All American Coffee LLC brings that depth of experience to every client relationship —
combining East African sourcing expertise with US-based processing and a commitment to quality,
transparency, and individual solutions.

**Is BlueCart a wholesale management system for distributors of all sizes?**

Yes. BlueCart is used by wholesale businesses ranging from small independent distributors to large
multi-warehouse operations. The platform scales with your business, giving small distributors the
same order management, catalog, and invoicing tools as larger operations without enterprise-level
pricing or complexity. Whether you are just starting to sell wholesale online or looking to replace
a legacy wholesale management system, BlueCart can be set up and running within days.

**What makes BlueCart different from other software for distributors?**

Most software for distributors focuses on one part of the operation, such as inventory or invoicing,
and requires separate tools for everything else. BlueCart brings the full operation together: a
buyer-facing ecommerce storefront, per-account catalog and pricing management, order management,
inventory tracking, delivery route management, invoicing and payment collection, and a CRM for
managing buyer relationships. Everything runs in one platform, which means your data stays
consistent and your team works from a single system rather than switching between multiple tools.

**Can I choose how and where I deliver orders?**

Yes. You can offer local delivery, nationwide shipping, or both by setting up separate catalogs. You
can also fulfill orders using your own drivers, third-party logistics, or your preferred
distributor. BlueCart is built to fit your existing workflow.

## What Is Liquid Coffee Concentrate?

Liquid coffee concentrate is brewed coffee reduced down to its purest, most potent form. Think of it
like the essence of espresso, but without the machine. A small amount goes a long way: just 10 ml of
STIR makes a full 100 ml cup of coffee. No grinding, no brewing, no waiting.

It's new to India, but it's been the quiet secret of cafés and specialty coffee lovers worldwide for
years. Now it's yours.

1
Pour 10 ml of STIR
Use the measuring spoon included in every order. 10 ml is your base, go up to 15 ml for a stronger,
bolder cup.
2
Add your liquid
Top up with 90 ml of hot water, cold water, cold milk, hot milk, whatever you like. That's your 100
ml cup right there.
3
Stir and done
Give it a quick stir. For iced coffee, just pour over ice, you're done in under 60 seconds. No
machine, no mess, no skill required.
Is this the same as instant coffee?
Not even close. Instant coffee is spray-dried or freeze-dried powder, the process strips most of the
flavour and aroma. STIR is brewed liquid concentrate made from specialty Arabica. It tastes like
real coffee, because it is real coffee.
Do I need any special equipment?
Nothing. No espresso machine, no French press, no filter setup. Just the concentrate, a cup, and
whatever liquid you have in your kitchen. A 10 ml measuring spoon is included with every order.
Can I use it for iced coffee?
That's where it really shines. Fill a glass with ice, pour 90 ml milk of your choice, top with 10–15
ml of STIR. Iced latte in under 60 seconds, no dilution, no bitterness.
How does it compare to café coffee?
STIR is made from the same single-origin specialty Arabica beans that specialty cafés use, brewed at
the right concentration and sealed fresh. The result is a clean, nuanced cup, not the over-extracted
bitterness of most home methods.
How long does it last?
1 year sealed. Once opened, store it sealed and refrigerated, it stays fresh for 20 days. At 10 ml
per cup, a 200 ml pouch gives you about 20 cups and a 900 ml gives you about 90.

## ABOUT US

CCL Products (India) Limited is a public limited company, established in 1994 with a mission to
produce premium-quality coffee that meets the highest global standards. Guided by core values of
integrity, commitment, customer focus, and quality excellence, CCL Products has steadily grown into
a major player in the coffee industry. Our robust infrastructure and dedication to innovation have
helped us build a strong presence in over 110+ countries. Today, we are recognised as the largest
exporter of instant coffee and a leading private label manufacturer worldwide.

## BREWING COFFEE AS YOU LIKE IT!

### The Best In Trade And Taste

CCL Products is one of the most trusted names in the coffee industry, remaining steadfast in its
commitment to delivering exceptional quality. With a selection of fine coffee varieties, we
customise our offerings to cater to diverse tastes and preferences, ensuring every product aligns
with the unique needs of our customers.

[

#### PRODUCTS

][12]

[With over 1000 delicious coffee blends crafted to energise every day, CCL Products stands at the
forefront of coffee innovation. Backed by state-of-the-art infrastructure and advanced manufacturing
facilities, we produce a wide array of coffee varieties, including ][13][Spray Dried Coffee
Powder][14], [Spray-Dried Agglomerated Coffee][15], [Freeze Concentrated Liquid Coffee][16], [Roast
& Ground Coffee][17], [Roasted Coffee Beans][18], [Freeze Dried Coffee][19] and [Premix Coffee][20].

##### [know more][21]

[

#### PACKAGING

We offer premium packaging solutions designed to preserve freshness and aroma. Our packaging
capabilities include both retail and bulk packaging options, such as jars, cans, pouches, sachets,
big bags, bulk boxes, and drums.

][22]

##### [know more][23]

[

#### OUR BRANDS

With over 30 years of experience and expertise in crafting 1000+ blends, we have introduced our own
brands to the Indian and international markets. Our offerings span various categories, including
Instant, Roast & Ground, and Premix Coffee, under the brand names Xtra, Speciale, Freeze Dried,
Malgudi, and THIS.

][24]

## Establish 2024

# From Indian Coffee Farms
# To Exceptional Cups.

B2B Coffee Supply & Private Label Manufacturing

Mikado Food & Beverages sources premium coffee beans directly from India’s finest coffee regions and
transforms them through precision roasting and modern processing.

[ Explore our Coffee ][13]

## Great coffee begins long before roasting.

At Mikado, the essence of a perfect cup is rooted in the soil. Our journey starts in Karnataka and
Kerala, working with traditional growers who have mastered sustainable cultivation over generations.

develop the most delightful flavor profile for each unique lot of coffee. Our core philosophy is
refreshingly simple: to offer you coffees we find irresistible.

## About VCU

**Vietnam Coffee United Joint Stock Company** | VCU JSC was established in 2022, specializing in the
production of green coffee beans and roasted Robusta, Arabica, and Excelsa coffee beans. VCU
provides the most popular types of coffee grown in the famous production regions of Vietnam.

After many years of development, VCU has become one of the reputable and renowned coffee producers
and exporters in Vietnam. Each year, VCU exports a large volume of Robusta and Arabica coffee to
many countries such as the Philippines, Japan, Bangladesh, Israel, Australia, and more.

Volcafe is one of the largest traders of Arabica and Robusta coffees, providing the beans for 66
billion cups of coffee each year. Drawing on our long history in the coffee trade, we aim to be the
world's best coffee partner.

Our expertise spans green coffee procurement and preparation, quality control, risk management, and
logistics. Our [network of buying and selling offices][79] covers over 90 percent of world
production.

Volcafe’s [Sustainability Strategy][80] works in three areas to achieve *sustainable profitability*
for farmers, promote *regenerative practices* to combat climate change, and support thriving
communities through *responsible citizenship*.

### About Wilbur Curtis

For almost 80 years, the Wilbur Curtis Company has helped customers master serving a great cup of
coffee through groundbreaking products, sheer drive and ingenuity, and a keen knowledge of the
[foodservice coffee][120] business.

From a full array of [commercial coffee brewers][121] and [iced tea brewers][122] to [hot water
dispensers][123] and an array of [satellite dispensers][124] and [thermal dispensers][125], our
innovative equipment offers advanced technology and labor savings to our customers.

The pinnacle of Curtis innovation, GemX combines brains and brilliant design elements to power a
[batch brew][126] coffee program with the ultimate in freshness.

Our ThermoProX precision [thermal brewer][127], delivers unsurpassed efficiency and intuitive
technology in a dazzling, new design.

But there’s more to the story. Our R&D team stays in front of the latest trends. Our account
associates are coffee connoisseurs who take a personal interest in their customers’ success. And our
long-tenured manufacturing teams are true craftspeople with an unwavering eye on quality. Love of
great coffee is what’s made us successful — and what keeps us driving on.

combining East African sourcing expertise with US-based processing and a commitment to quality,

**How does the Endless Aisle help me reach new restaurant buyers?**

The Endless Aisle connects your catalog with restaurants actively placing orders on BlueCart. Your
products become visible to buyers in your delivery area (many of whom are looking for new local
suppliers).

**How can buyers find my products on the Endless Aisle?**

Buyers can find your products on the Endless Aisle by searching relevant keywords or browsing
categories in their market. When a new vendor goes live, buyers in the same area will oftentimes see
a pop-up highlighting your brand and logo to help drive initial visibility to your products.

**Do you have a tool to streamline all my orders?**

Yes, BlueCart has an all-inclusive order management system that enables vendors to increase sales
and better serve their customers. As a vendor using Endless Aisle, you'll automatically have access
to this must-have feature.

**Is BlueCart a wholesale management system for distributors of all sizes?**

Yes. BlueCart is used by wholesale businesses ranging from small independent distributors to large
multi-warehouse operations. The platform scales with your business, giving small distributors the
same order management, catalog, and invoicing tools as larger operations without enterprise-level
pricing or complexity. Whether you are just starting to sell wholesale online or looking to replace
a legacy wholesale management system, BlueCart can be set up and running within days.

**What makes BlueCart different from other software for distributors?**

Most software for distributors focuses on one part of the operation, such as inventory or invoicing,
and requires separate tools for everything else. BlueCart brings the full operation together: a
buyer-facing ecommerce storefront, per-account catalog and pricing management, order management,
inventory tracking, delivery route management, invoicing and payment collection, and a CRM for
managing buyer relationships. Everything runs in one platform, which means your data stays
consistent and your team works from a single system rather than switching between multiple tools.

**Can I choose how and where I deliver orders?**

Yes. You can offer local delivery, nationwide shipping, or both by setting up separate catalogs. You
can also fulfill orders using your own drivers, third-party logistics, or your preferred
distributor. BlueCart is built to fit your existing workflow.

## Establish 2024

# From Indian Coffee Farms
# To Exceptional Cups.

B2B Coffee Supply & Private Label Manufacturing

Mikado Food & Beverages sources premium coffee beans directly from India’s finest coffee regions and
transforms them through precision roasting and modern processing.

[ Explore our Coffee ][13]

## Great coffee begins long before roasting.

At Mikado, the essence of a perfect cup is rooted in the soil. Our journey starts in Karnataka and
Kerala, working with traditional growers who have mastered sustainable cultivation over generations.

We prioritize direct-trade relationships for ethical sourcing. By removing middlemen, we invest back
into farms, supporting biodiversity and precision harvesting for unparalleled flavor profiles.

*“Our commitment is to the land as much as it is to the liquid in your cup.”*

Our Portfolio

## What We Supply

Comprehensive coffee solutions tailored for global distribution and high-volume industrial
requirements.

Classic Heritage

### Green Coffee Beans

Premium Arabica and Robusta beans sourced from trusted plantations across India and beyond.

Estate Reserve

### Roasted Coffee Beans

Our AAA and AA grade Arabica and Robusta beans are roasted in small batches to highlight distinct
terroir.

Modern Extraction

### Instant Coffee POWDER

High-grade spray-dried and freeze-dried options for maximum solubility and aroma.

Modern Extraction

### Liquid Concentrate

Consistent, high-quality liquid coffee concentrate designed for large-scale industrial use.

[ Explore All Blends ][14]

## The Journey

Transparency in every gram. Follow the transformation of our 

beans from the high hills of India to your morning ritual.

01

### Harvest

Selectively hand-picked at peak ripeness between November and March to ensure maximum sugar content.

02

### Processing

Washed, Honey, or Natural processing methods applied at the source to define the flavor foundation.

03

### Roasting

Precision roasting using Giesen technology, monitored by Q-graders for consistent profile execution.

04

### Packaging

Nitrogen-flushed packaging with one-way valves to lock in freshness for up to 12 months.

## Supplying the brands you know and trust.

## 1g - 100kg

Versatile Packaging Options

## We Scale With You

## Flexible Packaging for Every Stage of Your Brand

Whether you’re launching a new coffee label or supplying large distribution networks, our packaging
solutions adapt to your scale.

From **1g trial sachets to 100kg+ industrial supply**, Mikado supports businesses with packaging
formats that match their growth.
* Premium Pouches (Stick packs to 1kg bags)
* Customized Glass and PET Jars
* Industrial Bulk Sacks for Manufacturing

shops, restaurants, and other foodservice businesses through our wholesale services.

production.

### About Wilbur Curtis

For almost 80 years, the Wilbur Curtis Company has helped customers master serving a great cup of
coffee through groundbreaking products, sheer drive and ingenuity, and a keen knowledge of the
[foodservice coffee][120] business.

From a full array of [commercial coffee brewers][121] and [iced tea brewers][122] to [hot water
dispensers][123] and an array of [satellite dispensers][124] and [thermal dispensers][125], our
innovative equipment offers advanced technology and labor savings to our customers.

The pinnacle of Curtis innovation, GemX combines brains and brilliant design elements to power a
[batch brew][126] coffee program with the ultimate in freshness.

Our ThermoProX precision [thermal brewer][127], delivers unsurpassed efficiency and intuitive
technology in a dazzling, new design.

But there’s more to the story. Our R&D team stays in front of the latest trends. Our account
associates are coffee connoisseurs who take a personal interest in their customers’ success. And our
long-tenured manufacturing teams are true craftspeople with an unwavering eye on quality. Love of
great coffee is what’s made us successful — and what keeps us driving on.
